Question
========
What is the role of quality control (QC)?

Answerlist
----------
* planning data collection wisely
* detecting and correcting errors after collection
* deleting outliers and handling missing values that might later distort statistical analysis
* choosing high-quality sources for data gathering


Solution
========
The role of quality control is detecting and correcting errors after collection.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
